note: OCT30-INFRA-S015: signing, verification and separate (never Latest) publication of one retained, already-compiled Rango (Pixel 10 Pro Fold) build by scripts/rango-retained.py, reusing the Frankel primitives (host-sign.py, host_secrets.py, release-pipeline.py checks, github_release_publisher.py). No compile, app rebuild, key generation or bootstrap. Every null below is an unbound real input: the route refuses before any controller, login or secret access while any is null. Values are never copied from Frankel or guessed.

input.transportBasis: Unbound: no supported transport moves the Mac operator's retained outputs to the original builder. The validated local interface is a directory holding exactly the receipt, target-files and otatools; it is staged into a fresh task-owned consumer directory and revalidated before secrets.

signing.bootstrapReceiptBasis: Unbound: the public receipt of a genuine completed fold-rango-v1 bootstrap names the committed secret versions and the OTA certificate and AVB public key identities. No bootstrap has run.
signing.provenanceBasis: Unbound: executable otatools and the release script need an approved source binding (pinned revision and content hashes), not only the artifact's self-reported hashes.

publication.feedBasis: Unbound: automatic Rango OTA discovery is not established by a GitHub tag and no Rango channel routing is configured; the feed line asset needs a selected channel.
publication.notesBasis: Unbound: UPDATE.md for this build must come from an immutable reviewed commit; none names rango 2026103001.

verification.basis: Unbound: Rango-specific expected APK/APEX/image/updater identities for the release-pipeline checks; Frankel's updater, framework and feed identities are never claimed for Rango.
